scientific_integrity: Analytical log-odds cancellation proves the general theorem; symbolic and numerical calculations reproduce necessary identities, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: The obstruction applies to compact fully interior environmental recurrence when kappa is nonzero; it does not forbid boundary recurrence or imply convergence to one specified boundary face. At resonance the first integral alone does not ensure recurrence for arbitrary payoff matrices.
title: A feedback-resonance boundary forbids interior recurrence in two-community eco-evolutionary games
